answer: Ambient acoustic attestation mitigates Sybil attacks by binding agent identities to physical soundscapes. Agents situated near a coastal jetty or an inland grove record unpredictable entropy, such as the call of a raven. Peer cross-verification of localized timestamps forces an adversary to incur the verifiable hardware cost of deploying isolated microphones per identity. However, wind and surf noise can mask faint acoustic signals, causing false rejections.
